cause: Bazel not installed or not in PATH
fix: Install Bazelisk or Bazel; run "where bazel"

cause: Running from wrong directory
fix: cd X:/ then re-run; script needs MODULE.bazel or .git parent

cause: native_core_runtime.toml deleted or repo damaged
fix: Check file at X:/runtime/native_core_runtime.toml; re-clone if needed

cause: runtime/native/src/ missing
fix: git status / re-clone repo

cause: C compilation error, cold server, or disk full
fix: See Entry 3 (Bazel Cache) and Entry 7 (Cold Bazel Server)

cause: Server not ready or build never succeeded
fix: Run bazel build first; see Entry 7

cause: Build produced no objects or wrong config
fix: See Entry 1; check --config matches

cause: Neither llvm-lib nor lib.exe installed
fix: Install LLVM (scoop install llvm) or VS Build Tools

cause: llvm-lib or lib.exe crashed on .obj files
fix: Try manually: llvm-lib /OUT:test.lib *.obj in obj dir

cause: A running process holds the .lib
fix: Kill kain.exe/kn.exe/ui_test.exe; re-run update_runtime.py

error: runtime library NOT found after archive
cause: Archive step said OK but .lib didn't appear
fix: Disk full? Permission error on .kain/lib/? Check dir X:/.kain/lib/

cause: .lib is corrupt or incompatible
fix: Try --skip-build to re-archive; if still fails .obj files are bad

cause: TOML file has syntax errors
fix: Validate TOML; try py -3 tools/bazel/sync_native_runtime_builds.py

cause: Env var points to wrong location
fix: See Entry 5 (Runtime Library Not Found by Compiler)

cause: Bug in the script itself
fix: Report the traceback; script at scripts/python/update_runtime.py

cause: .c files changed but .lib wasn't rebuilt
fix: Run py -3 scripts/python/update_runtime.py

cause: New .c file not added to manifest
fix: Add to native_core_runtime.toml; regen with --manifest

symptom: Bazel returns old objects after .c change
cause: Disk cache has stale hash matching changed file
fix: Run bazel build --disk_cache= or bazel clean --expunge

cause: MCP tool only syncs compiler binary, not runtime lib
fix: Run py -3 scripts/python/update_runtime.py separately

cause: KAIN.exe/kn.exe process holds the file locked
fix: taskkill /F /IM kain.exe; taskkill /F /IM kn.exe

symptom: Commands hang 30-90 seconds; script times out
cause: Bazel server needs warming or restart
fix: Check server_pid; run bazel info; or bazel shutdown + restart

symptom: update_runtime.py times out at build step
cause: Bazel server is cold or uninitialized
fix: bazel shutdown; bazel info --config=dev to warm up

error: source uses runtime features but no library
symptom: Compile error; cannot find runtime lib
cause: KAIN_HOME/lib/kain_runtime.lib missing
fix: Set KAIN_RUNTIME_LIB_PATH or run update_runtime.py

cause: Python 3 not installed or not in PATH
fix: Install Python 3; ensure python.exe in PATH

error: Bazel path mangling in Git Bash
symptom: Build command fails with path error
cause: Git Bash mangles //runtime:... into filesystem path
fix: Use PowerShell or py -3 to run Bazel commands
